claims.statement: The MACE v0.3.13 notes state a new MLIAP interface for LAMMPS, CuEquivariance GPU support in LAMMPS models, and multi-GPU inference via MPI message passing of intermediate tensors.
The supplied patch_4July2026 excerpt only says 'LAMMPS feature release 4 July 2026' and gives no itemized changes or commits.

questions: What do the full patch_4July2026 release notes and commit list say about potentials, integrators, ensembles, and GPU/KOKKOS packages?
report.summary: The supplied LAMMPS patch_4July2026 excerpt contains only the title line 'LAMMPS feature release 4 July 2026'. It lists no items or commits, so it cannot show which changes affect potentials, integrators, ensembles, or GPU/KOKKOS packages. The only substantive content is the MACE v0.3.13 release notes. These describe a new MLIAP interface for LAMMPS, CuEquivariance GPU support, multi-GPU MPI inference, atomic stresses and virials, and MACE-MATPES foundation models. They are relevant to ML-potential use with LAMMPS but are not LAMMPS patch notes. The excerpt is also truncated, and no link between the MACE release and the LAMMPS patch is shown. The question cannot be answered from this evidence.
